name: Short-term (weekly) reversal
rules_plain: Rank by last week's return: last week's biggest losers bullish, biggest winners bearish
source: Lehmann (1990) Fads, Martingales, and Market Efficiency, QJE; Jegadeesh (1990) JF
prior_claim: US: weekly and monthly losers outperform winners next period
status: train: edge -0.03 week-bull / 2.48 week-bear

name: Daily reversal after an extreme day
rules_plain: After a very large down day, bullish next day; after a very large up day, bearish
default_params: move threshold in daily sigma, e.g. 2
prior_claim: Prices tend to partly reverse after liquidity-driven extreme days
status: train: edge -1.10 day-bull / 4.34 day-bear

name: Price momentum 12-1
rules_plain: Rank by return over the past 12 months skipping the latest month: top bullish, bottom bearish
source: Jegadeesh and Titman (1993) Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers, JF
prior_claim: US: winners keep outperforming for 3-12 months; horizon longer than ours, test whether any of it shows at one week
status: train: edge 0.21 week-bull / 0.85 week-bear

name: 52-week-high proximity
rules_plain: Close / 52-week high: nearest to the high bullish, farthest bearish
source: George and Hwang (2004) The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing, JF
prior_claim: US: closeness to 52-week high predicts returns better than past return alone
status: train: edge 1.92 week-bull / -0.50 week-bear

name: MAX effect (lottery stocks)
rules_plain: Highest single-day return over the past month: high MAX bearish, low MAX bullish
source: Bali, Cakici and Whitelaw (2011) Maxing Out, JFE
prior_claim: US: stocks with extreme recent up-days underperform
status: train: edge n/a week-bull (score never positive, v1 not centred) / -0.28 week-bear

name: Low volatility / idiosyncratic volatility
rules_plain: Low recent volatility bullish, high volatility bearish
source: Ang, Hodrick, Xing and Zhang (2006) The Cross-Section of Volatility and Expected Returns, JF
prior_claim: US: high idiosyncratic-volatility stocks earn low returns
status: train: edge 1.55 week-bull / 0.15 week-bear, dir. move negative both sides (research/diagnostics/a06.md)

name: High-volume return premium
rules_plain: Unusually high volume last week (vs own history) bullish, unusually low bearish
source: Gervais, Kaniel and Mingelgrin (2001) The High-Volume Return Premium, JF
prior_claim: US: unusual volume spikes are followed by higher returns
status: train: edge -1.42 week-bull / -0.84 week-bear, both sides reversed vs paper (research/diagnostics/a07.md)

name: Overnight vs intraday tug of war
rules_plain: Stocks with strong past overnight returns but weak intraday returns: bearish for open-to-close, and the reverse
source: Lou, Polk and Skouras (2019) A Tug of War: Overnight Versus Intraday Expected Returns, JFE
prior_claim: US: persistent split between overnight and intraday return components; directly relevant because our day picks are open-to-close
status: train: edge 0.04 day-bull / 1.15 day-bear

name: Gap fade
rules_plain: Large gap up at the open bearish for open-to-close, large gap down bullish
source: Practitioner gap-trading literature; related to A08
prior_claim: Opening gaps partly fill intraday
status: train: edge 0.87 day-bull / 3.21 day-bear

name: Gap and go
rules_plain: Gap up on strong volume above resistance bullish open-to-close (the opposite bet to A09; test both)
testable_now: partly (opening volume unavailable; prior-day volume only)
prior_claim: Competes with A09; whichever direction holds on NSE is the finding
status: untested

name: Day-of-week effect
rules_plain: Bias picks by weekday based on train-period weekday base rates
source: French (1980) Stock Returns and the Weekend Effect, JFE
prior_claim: US: historically weak Mondays; many calendar effects faded after publication
status: train: day-bear only, edge -1.15; not a test of the claim (one score per date, alphabetical top 5; research/diagnostics/calendar.md)

name: Turn-of-month effect
rules_plain: Bullish tilt in the last day and first 3 days of a month
source: Ariel (1987) A Monthly Effect in Stock Returns, JFE
prior_claim: US: returns concentrated around the turn of the month
status: train: week-bear -2.72 (177 dates), week-bull 8 dates only; not a test of the claim (research/diagnostics/calendar.md)

name: Pre-holiday effect
rules_plain: Bullish tilt on the trading day before an NSE holiday
source: Ariel (1990) High Stock Returns before Holidays, JF
prior_claim: US: pre-holiday days earn unusually high returns
status: train: day-bear +2.21 (60 dates), day-bull 1 date; not a test of the claim (research/diagnostics/calendar.md)

name: F&O expiry-week effect
rules_plain: Different behaviour in the week of the monthly F&O expiry
prior_claim: Claimed volatility and reversal around expiry; test it
status: train: zero picks both horizons, likely expiry_futstk missing in dataset (research/diagnostics/c04.md)

name: SMA crossover 20/50
rules_plain: Fast SMA above slow SMA bullish, below bearish (StockStalker's current trend signal)
prior_claim: Widely used; weak evidence at short horizons
status: train: edge -1.46 day-bull / 1.89 day-bear / -1.81 week-bull / 3.20 week-bear; dir. move negative all cells (research/diagnostics/t01.md)

name: Golden/death cross 50/200
rules_plain: 50-day SMA crossing above 200-day bullish, below bearish
prior_claim: Popular in media; trend signal, slow
status: train: edge n/a day-bull / n/a day-bear / 1.09 week-bull / 2.05 week-bear (week only); dir after costs negative both sides; not P1-eligible; see research/diagnostics/t02.md

name: RSI 30/70
rules_plain: RSI(14) below 30 bullish (oversold), above 70 bearish (overbought)
source: Wilder (1978) New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems
prior_claim: Most common retail rule; also test 20/80
status: train: edge -1.13 day-bull / 0.89 day-bear / -0.33 week-bull / 1.72 week-bear; dir after costs negative all four; not P1-eligible; see research/diagnostics/t03.md

name: Connors RSI-2
rules_plain: Price above 200-day SMA and RSI(2) under 10 bullish; below 200-day SMA and RSI(2) over 90 bearish
source: Connors and Alvarez (2009) Short Term Trading Strategies That Work
prior_claim: US equities: short-term mean reversion inside a long-term trend
status: train: edge 3.37 day-bull / 2.32 day-bear (day only); bull 6/6 years but gross move about 0 so dir -0.415% after delivery cost; not P1-eligible (research/diagnostics/t04.md)

name: MACD crossover
rules_plain: MACD line crossing above signal bullish, below bearish
prior_claim: Common retail signal
status: train: edge -2.86 day-bull / -0.06 day-bear / -3.90 week-bull / 2.02 week-bear; up-cross significantly wrong-way; week-bear P1-eligible (research/diagnostics/t05.md)

name: Bollinger %B mean reversion
rules_plain: Close below the lower band bullish, above the upper band bearish
prior_claim: Mean reversion at band extremes
status: train: edge 1.04 day-bull / 3.35 day-bear (day only); bear 6/6 years, StepM superior, but dir -0.03% after costs; not P1-eligible (research/diagnostics/t06.md)

name: Bollinger squeeze breakout
rules_plain: Band width at a 6-month low, then close outside a band: direction of the break
prior_claim: Volatility contraction precedes expansion
status: train: edge 1.79 week-bull / 11.28 week-bear (week only) on 18 and 10 picks: too few to read (P1 needs 500); not P1-eligible; see research/diagnostics/t07.md

name: Donchian / Turtle breakout
rules_plain: Close at a 20-day high bullish, at a 20-day low bearish (55-day variant too)
prior_claim: Trend-following on futures; test on stock futures
status: train: 20-day edge -3.97 week-bull / -2.72 week-bear; 55-day -5.09 / -0.90 (week only); every breakout wrong-way (all-picks too); not P1-eligible (research/diagnostics/t08.md)

name: Supertrend
rules_plain: Close above the ATR-based Supertrend line bullish, below bearish
source: Seban (Supertrend); very popular in Indian retail
prior_claim: Popular on Indian TradingView and Telegram
status: train: edge -2.51 day-bull / 0.32 day-bear / -3.18 week-bull / -0.11 week-bear; bull significantly wrong-way on both horizons, in the ranking (all-picks near 0); not P1-eligible (research/diagnostics/t09.md)

name: NR7 / NR4 narrow range
rules_plain: Narrowest range of the last 7 (or 4) days: pick next day in the direction of the trend filter
source: Crabel (1990) Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns
prior_claim: Range contraction precedes expansion
status: train: NR7 edge 2.16 day-bull / -0.55 day-bear; NR4 1.34 / -0.23 (day only); bull 6/6 years (NR7) but dir -0.49% after delivery cost; not P1-eligible (research/diagnostics/t10.md)

name: Inside bar
rules_plain: Today's range inside yesterday's: next day in the direction of the trend filter
prior_claim: Contraction pattern
status: train: edge -0.37 day-bull / -0.08 day-bear (day only); no edge either side; see research/diagnostics/t11.md

name: Stochastic %K/%D
rules_plain: %K crossing up below 20 bullish, crossing down above 80 bearish
prior_claim: Oscillator, mean reversion
status: train: edge -4.53 day-bull / -0.31 day-bear (day only); bull significantly wrong-way, 0/6 years; flip would mirror to about +4.5 but about 0.00% after costs, not queued (research/diagnostics/t12.md)

name: Williams %R
rules_plain: %R below -80 bullish, above -20 bearish
prior_claim: Oscillator
status: train: edge -0.28 day-bull / 2.89 day-bear (day only); bear 6/6 years, StepM superior, edge is in the ranking (all-picks +0.91), dir -0.02% after costs; not P1-eligible (research/diagnostics/t13.md)

name: CCI
rules_plain: CCI crossing above -100 bullish, below +100 bearish
prior_claim: Oscillator
status: train: edge -2.44 day-bull / -1.29 day-bear / -0.63 week-bull / -1.61 week-bear; no edge, all four negative; see research/diagnostics/t14.md

name: ADX trend filter
rules_plain: Use ADX > 25 to choose trend rules, < 20 to choose mean-reversion rules
prior_claim: A regime filter, best tested combined with others
status: train: edge -0.64 day-bull / 2.20 day-bear / -1.15 week-bull / 2.95 week-bear; week-bear dir. move +0.02% (P1 by the letter; research/diagnostics/t15.md)

name: Parabolic SAR
rules_plain: Price above SAR bullish, below bearish
prior_claim: Trend-following stop system
status: untested

name: Keltner channel breakout
rules_plain: Close above the upper Keltner channel bullish, below the lower bearish
source: Keltner (1960); ATR version popularised by Raschke
prior_claim: Breakout
status: untested

name: Ichimoku cloud
rules_plain: Price above the cloud with Tenkan above Kijun bullish, the reverse bearish
prior_claim: Popular trend system
status: untested

name: OBV divergence
rules_plain: Price making a lower low while OBV makes a higher low bullish, and the reverse bearish
prior_claim: Volume confirms or diverges from price
status: untested

name: Volume breakout
rules_plain: Close in the top 25% of the day's range on volume over 2x the 20-day average: bullish next day (mirror for bearish)
prior_claim: Breakouts on volume continue
status: untested

name: Minervini trend template
rules_plain: Price above the 50, 150 and 200-day SMAs, 150 > 200, 200 rising, near the 52-week high: bullish; mirror conditions bearish
source: Minervini (2013) Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard
prior_claim: Stage-2 uptrend filter
status: queued

name: VCP (volatility contraction pattern)
rules_plain: Successively smaller pullbacks with falling volume inside a trend template: bullish on breakout
prior_claim: Popular base-breakout pattern
status: untested

name: Relative strength rating
rules_plain: Rank by weighted 3/6/9/12-month return vs the universe: top bullish, bottom bearish
source: O'Neil, How to Make Money in Stocks (CANSLIM RS rating)
prior_claim: Leaders keep leading
status: queued

name: Classic pivot points
rules_plain: Open above the pivot bullish, below bearish; bounce or break at S1/R1
prior_claim: Widely watched intraday levels
status: untested

name: Heikin-Ashi trend
rules_plain: Consecutive Heikin-Ashi candles with no lower (upper) wick: bullish (bearish)
prior_claim: Smoothed trend reading
status: queued

name: OI build-up classification
rules_plain: Price up with OI up = long build-up (bullish); price down with OI up = short build-up (bearish); unwinding and covering treated as weaker
prior_claim: Standard daily F&O desk reading; untested here
status: train: edge -4.61 day-bull / -2.48 day-bear

name: Stock put-call ratio
rules_plain: Extreme PCR from stock options OI: contrarian or confirmatory, test both
testable_now: yes (unlocked 22 Oct: near-month options OI summed by type, oi_ce_optstk/oi_pe_optstk, already flows through the existing cm/fo cache - no .github/ wiring needed, see build_dataset.py)
prior_claim: Sentiment gauge; direction of effect disputed
status: train: contrarian edge -0.38 week-bull / +3.75 week-bear (dir. move +0.16%, P1 candidate); confirmatory -3.99 / +0.04 (research/diagnostics/d02.md)

name: Delivery percentage spike
rules_plain: Delivery % well above the stock's own 20-day average on an up day bullish, on a down day bearish
data_needed: NSE security-wise delivery file (MTO; scripts/fetch_delivery.py + build_dataset.py parse it; not yet in the Actions-cached dataset)
testable_now: no (fetcher+parser written 22 Oct; needs backfill.yml/dataset.yml wiring - see state/engine-issues.md)
prior_claim: Claimed sign of genuine buying; no published return test found
status: untested

name: Bulk and block deals
rules_plain: Stocks with large disclosed bulk-deal buys bullish, sells bearish
data_needed: NSE bulk/block deal files (not yet fetched)
source: Indian event-study literature on bulk deals
prior_claim: Abnormal returns around bulk deals reported in Indian studies
status: untested

name: Nifty200 Momentum 30 score
rules_plain: Normalised momentum score: z-scores of 6- and 12-month returns each divided by volatility, averaged
prior_claim: Index outperformed Nifty 200 in NSE's backtest (2020 whitepaper)
status: queued

name: Nifty Low Volatility 30 rule
rules_plain: Lowest 1-year daily volatility bullish, highest bearish
prior_claim: Low-vol had the best risk-adjusted profile in one Indian study
status: queued

name: PKScreener scanners
rules_plain: About 95 find*/validate* scanners; port the end-of-day ones one by one
prior_claim: Popular free NSE screener; scanners are untested signals
status: untested

name: Qlib Alpha158 features
rules_plain: 158 price/volume features; use as candidate signals, or rank-average groups of them
prior_claim: Standard feature set in Qlib benchmarks (China/US)
status: untested

name: 101 Formulaic Alphas
rules_plain: 101 short-horizon price/volume formulas, implemented from the paper's formulas
prior_claim: Real WorldQuant alphas with short holding periods; published so likely decayed
status: untested

name: Quantpedia free strategies
rules_plain: About 70 free strategy write-ups; select price-based ones that fit day or week
prior_claim: Mostly US/global academic anomalies
status: untested

name: Open Source Asset Pricing predictors
rules_plain: 319 replicated predictors; only the price-based subset fits our data
source: Chen and Zimmermann (2022) Critical Finance Review
prior_claim: US monthly; most need fundamentals
status: untested

name: IIMA Indian factors
rules_plain: Size, value and momentum factor returns for India; use as context and regime features
source: Agarwalla, Jacob and Varma, IIM Ahmedabad
prior_claim: Indian factor premia since 1993
status: untested

name: Order-block placebo (no impulse)
rules_plain: Last opposite-colour candle before ANY same-direction bar as the zone; score = closeness of price to the zone, signed by side. Same retest rule as O01 with the displacement and structure-break requirement removed.
default_params: impulse_atr=0, require_break=false; zone lookback 5 bars; max distance 2 ATR
prior_claim: If O01 does not beat this, the impulse that defines an order block adds nothing
status: train: edge -0.95 day-bull / -0.65 day-bear / -0.61 week-bull / -1.48 week-bear

name: Order-block retest
rules_plain: Bullish when a fresh unmitigated demand block (last down candle before a >=1.5 ATR up bar that closes above the 10-bar high) exists and price is back at the zone; bearish for supply blocks. Zone dies when a later close passes through its far side.
default_params: impulse 1.5 ATR; break 10 bars; zone lookback 5; max age 20; max distance 2 ATR
source: Smart-money / ICT order-block convention; vendor claims unverified
prior_claim: Popular with retail traders; no independent backtest found
status: train: edge -0.47 day-bull / 0.66 day-bear / -2.21 week-bull / 0.18 week-bear

name: Order block confirmed by OI build-up
rules_plain: O01's side, kept only when D01's OI build-up classification agrees (long build-up for bullish, short build-up for bearish); abstain otherwise. Day horizon only: D01 gives no week-horizon reading to gate on (cards/D01.yml).
prior_claim: Vendor shows OI state beside every order block
status: train: edge -5.15 day-bull / 0.01 day-bear

name: Order block confirmed by trend
rules_plain: O01's side, kept only when T01's SMA(20,50) spread has the same sign.
prior_claim: Tests whether order blocks are only a trend signal in disguise
status: train: edge -0.36 day-bull / 0.90 day-bear / -1.45 week-bull / -0.91 week-bear

name: Order-block composite (the 'conviction' guess)
rules_plain: Rank-average across the universe of O01 proximity, D01 OI score and 20-day volume z-score, signed by the O01 side; pick the extremes.
default_params: equal weights; abstain when O01 abstains
prior_claim: Closest guess to the vendor's ranked board; formula unpublished
status: train: edge -1.16 day-bull / -0.65 day-bear / -2.95 week-bull / -0.44 week-bear

name: Order block on weekly bars
rules_plain: O01 on weekly resampled bars for week-horizon tables.
prior_claim: Horizon sensitivity
status: train: edge 1.90 week-bull / 0.32 week-bear

name: Intraday order block with session VWAP (forward protocol)
rules_plain: 5-minute order blocks plus session VWAP side; scored forward only, on the archived 5-minute bars (60 sessions from 29 Jul 2026).
default_params: 5-minute bars; zone from the prior sessions
testable_now: no: needs a supervised workflow to read the cache; see state/engine-issues.md
prior_claim: Vendor refreshes each minute on intraday data
status: untested

name: OI build-up faded (contrarian D01)
rules_plain: D01's classification with the sign flipped: long build-up bearish, short build-up bullish, unwinding/covering fade at half strength. Pre-declared because D01 lost confidently in every train year (bullish t -8.15).
prior_claim: Broker lore says continuation; the lab's own data says the opposite
status: train: edge +2.54 day-bull / +4.74 day-bear, dir. move positive both sides; beats D01 by >7pt both sides (research/diagnostics/confluence.md)

name: A02 with an agreeing order-block zone
rules_plain: A02 extreme-day reversal kept only where O01 finds a zone on the same side as A02's pick (supply zone for a bearish pick); abstain otherwise.
prior_claim: Do order blocks add information to the family that already has edge
status: train: edge +0.59 day-bull / +4.31 day-bear, does not beat E1B or A02 outside noise (research/diagnostics/confluence.md)

name: A02 without an agreeing order-block zone
rules_plain: A02 kept only where O01 has no zone or a zone on the other side. The placebo direction for E1A.
prior_claim: If E1A does not beat E1B and A02 alone, order blocks add nothing here
status: train: edge -0.91 day-bull / +4.29 day-bear, reproduces A02 almost exactly; order blocks add nothing here (research/diagnostics/confluence.md)

name: A02 on a crowded move (OI rose)
rules_plain: A02 kept only where near-month futures OI rose on the extreme day. Hypothesis fixed in advance: crowded moves fade harder.
prior_claim: Indian OI build-up lore, tested both ways
status: train: edge -1.58 day-bull / +7.46 day-bear, dir. move day-bear turns positive; beats A02 by +3.12pt day-bear, interval above 0 (research/diagnostics/confluence.md)

name: A02 on a position-closing move (OI fell)
rules_plain: A02 kept only where futures OI fell or was flat on the extreme day. The opposite arm of E2A.
prior_claim: Tests the other direction so a result either way is reported
status: train: edge +0.88 day-bull / +2.34 day-bear, weaker than A02 day-bear; complements E2A's crowdedness finding (research/diagnostics/confluence.md)

name: MAX effect, cross-sectionally ranked (A05 v2)
rules_plain: A05's MAX/sigma ranked across stocks each date: mid-rank percentile, score 1 - 2*pct; most lottery-like bearish, least bullish
source: Bali, Cakici and Whitelaw (2011) Maxing Out, JFE; lab result research/diagnostics/a05.md
prior_claim: US: stocks with extreme recent up-days underperform (cross-sectional sort)
status: train: edge 2.23 week-bull / -0.28 week-bear, dir. move negative both sides; bearish identical to A05 (research/diagnostics/a05b.md)

name: High-volume premium faded (contrarian A07)
rules_plain: A07's volume z with the sign flipped: unusual volume spike last week bearish, volume drought bullish. Pre-declared because A07 was wrong-way on both sides in train.
prior_claim: US paper says spikes lead; the lab's NSE train data leans the other way
status: train: edge 0.90 week-bull / 1.34 week-bear, both intervals straddle 0; pre-declared rule not met, volume-z family closed (research/diagnostics/a07c.md)

name: Week-bearish consensus v1 (P2)
rules_plain: Rank-average of D02-contrarian, A01 and T15 bearish strength, abstain as neutral; bearish table only
prior_claim: Weak unrelated signals may add up; untested
status: train: edge n/a week-bull (bearish only) / 2.48 week-bear, dir +0.15%, interval above 0; pre-declared rule not met (research/diagnostics/consensus_wb_v1.md)

name: Day-bearish consensus v1 (P2)
rules_plain: Rank-average of E2A, D01C and A09 bearish strength, abstain as neutral; bearish table only
prior_claim: Weak unrelated signals may add up; untested
status: train: edge n/a day-bull (bearish only) / 4.61 day-bear, dir +0.07%, 6/6 years; lands on D01C; pre-declared rule not met (research/diagnostics/consensus_db_v1.md)

name: MACD up-cross faded (contrarian T05 bullish side)
rules_plain: T05's fresh MACD up-cross called bearish, scored by T05's magnitude; down-crosses abstain. Pre-declared because T05's up-cross was significantly wrong-way in train on both horizons.
prior_claim: Appel reads an up-cross as bullish; the lab's NSE train data leans the other way
status: train: edge n/a day-bull / 2.70 day-bear / n/a week-bull / 4.02 week-bear (bearish only); week meets pre-declared rule (interval +0.79 to +7.18, dir +0.24%), day fails on dir; in validation batch (research/diagnostics/t05c.md)

name: E2A first, D01C fallback (day-bearish)
rules_plain: Per date: E2A's bearish scores when E2A fires, otherwise D01C's; bearish table only. Pre-declared alternative to the rank-average consensus.
default_params: switch on any E2A bearish score
prior_claim: A strong intermittent reading backed by an always-on one; untested
status: train: edge n/a day-bull (bearish only) / 5.97 day-bear, dir +0.06%, coverage 94%; pre-declared rule not met (dir and coverage); P1-eligible, validation queried (research/diagnostics/e2a_d01c_fb.md)

name: O04 without the volume ingredient (ablation)
rules_plain: O04's rank-average of O01 proximity and D01 OI score only, signed by the O01 side; A07 volume z dropped.
default_params: equal weights; abstain when O01 abstains
prior_claim: Ablation of the lab's conviction guess; formula unpublished
status: train: edge -1.08 day-bull / -0.37 day-bear / -2.88 week-bull / -0.03 week-bear; within 0.4 of O04 everywhere, volume not O04's problem (research/diagnostics/o04_ablation.md)

name: O04 without the OI ingredient (ablation)
rules_plain: O04's rank-average of O01 proximity and A07 volume z only, signed by the O01 side; D01 OI score dropped.
default_params: equal weights; abstain when O01 abstains
prior_claim: Ablation of the lab's conviction guess; formula unpublished
status: train: edge 0.23 day-bull / 0.33 day-bear / -1.68 week-bull / -1.12 week-bear; beats O04 by 1+ on both bullish cells (D01 sank them) but not O01 (research/diagnostics/o04_ablation.md)
